payload.instruction: Move the book behind the flower
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: The book is moved behind the flower.
outcome.target: The book is spatially behind and visibly occluded by a flower in the edited image.
outcome.reference: Compare the source and edited images, assessing the book's position relative to a flower in the edited image; do not require the flower to be the same individual flower as in the source.

check.question: Has the book been moved behind a flower?
check.complete_when: In the edited image, a flower is spatially in front of the book and visibly occludes part of it, establishing that the book is behind the flower.
check.partial_when: Compared with the source arrangement, there is observable progress toward placing the book behind a flower, but the flower is not clearly in front of and occluding the book.
check.absent_when: Compared with the source arrangement, there is no observable progress toward placing the book behind a flower; the book remains separate from the flowers without the requested behind-and-occlusion relation.
check.unknown_when: The relevant book or flower is not sufficiently visible, or the images are genuinely too ambiguous to determine whether the book is behind and occluded by a flower or whether there was observable progress.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The book is still separate from both flowers in the edited image; neither flower overlaps or visibly occludes it, so there is no observable progress toward placing it behind a flower."}

parsed.evidence: The book is still separate from both flowers in the edited image; neither flower overlaps or visibly occludes it, so there is no observable progress toward placing it behind a flower.
